title: Volcano over Chaiten (3184408547).jpg
author: Jason Hollinger
credit: Volcano over Chaiten Uploaded by Amada44
description: This is one of the only photos of the active volcano that came out. It was very cloudy this early morning. By all accounts, Chaiten was quite a beautiful town, and had developed a great deal (including a beautiful boardwalk) in recent years. It is a ghost town now, buried for the most part 1 meter deep in ash. Very sad.
